contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: '- Read all application rows from staging.stg_lever__application. - Aggregate per posting_id: - first_app_sent_at: the earliest non-null created_at; if all created_at values are NULL, this is NULL. - count_referred_applications: number of rows where type equals ''referral''; exact match, NULL or other values do not count. - count_posting_applications: number of rows where type equals ''posting'' or ''agency''; exact matches only. - count_manual_user_applications: number of rows where type equals ''user''; exact match. - count_opportunities: number of distinct non-null opportunity_id. - count_open_opportunities: number of distinct non-null opportunity_id where archived_at is NULL. - Determine posting_hiring_manager_user_id by selecting, for each posting_id, the application with the latest created_at; if multiple rows share the same created_at or created_at is NULL, tie-breaking and NULL ordering follow the engine defaults; take that row''s posting_hiring_manager_user_id (may be NULL). - Inner join the aggregates with the latest-application selection on posting_id; posting_id values that are NULL do not match and are excluded, and only posting_ids with at least one application appear. - Output one row per non-null posting_id present in the application data.'

contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: 'Build candidate_journey by joining: - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle (cl) to staging.stg_lever__opportunity (o) on opportunity_id, left join intermediate.int_lever__contact_info (c) on contact_id, join staging.stg_lever__stage (s) on o.stage_id, and left join staging.stg_lever__archive_reason (ar) on o.archived_reason_id. - Derive fields: - activity_status: constant ''Active''. - lifecycle_speed_category: total_lifecycle_days bucketed as ≤14 ''Fast'', ≤30 ''Standard'', ≤60 ''Slow'', else ''Very Slow''. - interview_completion_rate_pct: completed_interviews divided by total_interviews times 100, rounded to 1 decimal; no explicit zero-division guard; NULLs propagate. - Carry through totals (interviews, completed, canceled), avg_interview_duration_minutes, total_interview_time_minutes, avg_recommendation_score, feedback_completion_rate_pct, is_archived, application_date (o.created_at), last_interaction_at, last_advanced_at, current_stage (s.stage_name), archive_reason (ar.archive_reason_title). Compute communication_quality per opportunity_id: - days_from_application_to_last_contact: difference in days between last_interaction_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - days_from_application_to_last_advancement: difference in days between last_advanced_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - response_quality from days_since_last_advancement: ≤1 ''Excellent Response (≤1 day)''; ≤3 ''Good Response (2-3 days)''; ≤7 ''Moderate Response (4-7 days)''; ≤14 ''Slow Response (8-14 days)''; else ''Very Slow Response (>14 days)'' (NULL falls to the else bucket). - transparency_score from feedback_completion_rate_pct: ≥90→5; ≥70→4; ≥50→3; ≥30→2; else 1 (NULL falls to 1). Compute interview_experience per opportunity_id: - interview_experience_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if completion rate ≥95 and avg duration in 30–90 minutes → 5. - Else if completion rate ≥80 and avg duration in 20–120 minutes → 4. - Else if completion rate ≥60 → 3; else if ≥40 → 2; else → 1. - interview_burden_category: - If total_interviews = 0 → ''No Interviews''. - Else if total_interviews ≤2 and total_interview_time_minutes ≤120 → ''Light Process''; ≤4 and ≤240 → ''Standard Process''; ≤6 and ≤360 → ''Intensive Process''; else ''Heavy Process''. - interview_consistency_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if canceled_interviews = 0 → 5; else if canceled/total ≤10% → 4; ≤20% → 3; ≤30% → 2; else → 1. Compute outcome_fairness per opportunity_id: - outcome_fairness_score: - If not archived → NULL. - Else 5 for stage indicating hire/accept or reason indicating withdrew/declined; 4 for offer stage or skills/qualification mismatch; 3 for culture fit issues or other; 2 if rejected without a stated reason. - process_completeness_assessment: - If not archived → ''In Progress''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≥4 and stage does not indicate hire → ''Potential Mismatch''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≤2 → ''Consistent Outcome''; else if avg_recommendation_score is NULL → ''Incomplete Process''; else → ''Normal Process''. Compute timeline_experience per opportunity_id: - timeline_experience_score compares lifecycle_speed_category to labels ''Fast Track (≤7 days)'', ''Normal (8-30 days)'', ''Extended (31-60 days)'', ''Long Process (>60 days)''; because candidate_journey uses ''Fast''/''Standard''/''Slow''/''Very Slow'', no label matches and the else branch applies, yielding 1 for all rows. - candidate_anxiety_level from activity_status: ''Active'' maps to ''Low Anxiety''. Final projection and derived fields: - overall_candidate_experience_score: weighted average of subscores (transparency 20%, interview experience 25%, interview consistency 15%, outcome fairness 20%, timeline 20%), defaulting missing subscores to 3, rounded to 1 decimal. - experience_grade from the same rounded overall score: ≥4.5 ''Exceptional Experience''; ≥4.0 ''Excellent Experience''; ≥3.5 ''Good Experience''; ≥3.0 ''Average Experience''; ≥2.0 ''Below Average Experience''; else ''Poor Experience''. - improvement_recommendations: concatenate in this order (each fragment ends with ''; '' and no trimming): if transparency_score ≤2 add ''Improve feedback transparency; ''; if interview_experience_score ≤2 add ''Optimize interview process; ''; if timeline_experience_score ≤2 add ''Accelerate decision timeline; ''; if days_since_last_advancement ≥14 add ''Increase communication frequency; ''. - experience_risk_flag (first match): if days_since_last_advancement ≥21 and not archived → ''High Abandonment Risk''; else if canceled_interviews ≥2 → ''Poor Interview Experience''; else if transparency_score ≤2 and total_interviews ≥3 → ''Low Process Transparency''; else if timeline_experience_score ≤2 and total_lifecycle_days ≥60 → ''Extended Timeline Concern''; else ''Normal''. - calculated_at = current timestamp at model execution. - Final result ordered by overall_candidate_experience_score descending, then total_lifecycle_days ascending.'

Compute outcome_fairness per opportunity_id: - outcome_fairness_score: - If not archived → NULL. - Else 5 for stage indicating hire/accept or reason indicating withdrew/declined; 4 for offer stage or skills/qualification mismatch; 3 for culture fit issues or other; 2 if rejected without a stated reason. - process_completeness_assessment: - If not archived → ''In Progress''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≥4 and stage does not indicate hire → ''Potential Mismatch''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≤2 → ''Consistent Outcome''; else if avg_recommendation_score is NULL → ''Incomplete Process''; else → ''Normal Process''. Compute timeline_experience per opportunity_id: - timeline_experience_score compares lifecycle_speed_category to labels ''Fast Track (≤7 days)'', ''Normal (8-30 days)'', ''Extended (31-60 days)'', ''Long Process (>60 days)''; because candidate_journey uses ''Fast''/''Standard''/''Slow''/''Very Slow'', no label matches and the else branch applies, yielding 1 for all rows. - candidate_anxiety_level from activity_status: ''Active'' maps to ''Low Anxiety''. Final projection and derived fields: - overall_candidate_experience_score: weighted average of subscores (transparency 20%, interview experience 25%, interview consistency 15%, outcome fairness 20%, timeline 20%), defaulting missing subscores to 3, rounded to 1 decimal. - experience_grade from the same rounded overall score: ≥4.5 ''Exceptional Experience''; ≥4.0 ''Excellent Experience''; ≥3.5 ''Good Experience''; ≥3.0 ''Average Experience''; ≥2.0 ''Below Average Experience''; else ''Poor Experience''. - improvement_recommendations: concatenate in this order (each fragment ends with ''; '' and no trimming): if transparency_score ≤2 add ''Improve feedback transparency; ''; if interview_experience_score ≤2 add ''Optimize interview process; ''; if timeline_experience_score ≤2 add ''Accelerate decision timeline; ''; if days_since_last_advancement ≥14 add ''Increase communication frequency; ''. - experience_risk_flag (first match): if days_since_last_advancement ≥21 and not archived → ''High Abandonment Risk''; else if canceled_interviews ≥2 → ''Poor Interview Experience''; else if transparency_score ≤2 and total_interviews ≥3 → ''Low Process Transparency''; else if timeline_experience_score ≤2 and total_lifecycle_days ≥60 → ''Extended Timeline Concern''; else ''Normal''. - calculated_at = current timestamp at model execution. - Final result ordered by overall_candidate_experience_score descending, then total_lifecycle_days ascending.'

contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: '- Build department_posting_base from postings: - Dimensions defaulted via COALESCE: department=''Unknown Department'', team=''Unknown Team'', location=''Unknown Location'', level=''Unknown Level'', commitment_type=''Unknown Commitment''. - Keep posting_id and timestamps; derive posting_month and posting_quarter by truncating created_at. - application_volume (dept+team+location+level+commitment_type+month+quarter): - Distinct counts: applications, candidates, opportunities, postings; referred applications where referrer_user_id is present. - referral_rate = referred applications / total applications * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no applications. - avg_applications_per_posting = total applications / active postings, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when active postings=0 (later COALESCE to 0). - hiring_outcomes (dept+team): - candidates_hired: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''hire'' or ''accept''; offers_extended: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''offer''. - Averages for hired/accepted only: time_to_hire (lifecycle days) and interviews_per_hire. - hire_conversion_rate = candidates_hired / distinct opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - offer_acceptance_rate = candidates_hired / offers_extended * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no offers. - interview_metrics (dept+team): - total_interviews_conducted: distinct interviews; completed when not canceled; canceled when canceled. - unique_interviewers: distinct interviewer users; avg_interview_duration: average interview duration (minutes); total_interview_time_minutes: sum of durations. - interview_completion_rate = completed / total * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no interviews. - feedback_completion_rate = 100 when any feedback exists else 0, rounded to 2 decimals. - candidate_quality (dept+team): - avg_candidate_experience_score: average overall_candidate_experience_score. - positive_experience_rate = exceptional/excellent experience opportunities / total opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - avg_screening_pass_rate: average application_to_screening_rate; high_efficiency_postings: distinct postings with hiring_efficiency_grade=''High Efficiency (≥10%)''. - cost_efficiency (dept+team): - Join dpb to application_volume, hiring_outcomes, and interview_metrics on dept+team; group by dept+team. - total_interview_hours = sum(total_interview_time_minutes) / 60.0. - interview_hours_per_hire = total_interview_hours / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - applications_per_hire = sum(total_applications) / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - hires_per_posting = total hires / sum(active_postings), rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no active postings. - cost_efficiency_tier by interview_hours_per_hire: ≤10 Highly Efficient, ≤20 Efficient, ≤40 Moderate Efficiency, >40 Low Efficiency; No Hires when hires=0 (later COALESCE to ''No Data'' if join missing). - Note: dept+team joins cause ho/im to repeat across each application_volume row and posting; sums aggregate repeated rows (scaled by both postings and application_volume rows per dept+team), while ratios dividing repeated sums (e.g., interview_hours_per_hire) cancel the scaling. - Final assembly: - Join department_posting_base to all aggregates on dept+team only, replicating dept+team metrics across each posting’s location/level/commitment slice and across application_volume slices. - Keep rows where application_volume.total_applications>0 OR application_volume.active_postings>0. - Ranks (global across the final set): hiring_volume_rank by candidates_hired DESC, conversion_efficiency_rank by hire_conversion_rate DESC, candidate_experience_rank by avg_candidate_experience_score DESC; ties share rank with gaps. - department_performance_score (0–100, rounded to 0 decimals, clamped): min(25, hires*2.5) + (hire_conversion_rate*0.2) + (interview_completion_rate*0.2) + (positive_experience_rate*0.15) + ([cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → 20 else 10]*0.2). - performance_tier: ≥75 Top Performing Department; ≥60 High Performing Department; ≥45 Standard Performing Department; else if total_applications≥10 Underperforming Department; otherwise Low Activity Department. - department_strength priority: referral_rate≥30 → offer_acceptance_rate≥80 → avg_candidate_experience_score≥4.0 → avg_time_to_hire_days≤30 → cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → else Standard Operations. - calculated_at = current_timestamp; final output ordered by department_performance_score DESC, then total_applications DESC.'

contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: '- Define hiring_manager_base: - From users keep access_role in {''admin'',''team_admin'',''limited''}. - Left join requisitions, postings, and applications (via postings) to compute workload: - total_requisitions_owned, total_postings_owned, total_applications_received, total_candidates_managed as distinct counts. - Keep only users with at least one requisition or posting. - Requisition performance per hiring_manager_user_id: - Distinct counts of requisitions by status: open, closed, filled. - avg_salary_range_width = mean of (compensation_band_max - compensation_band_min); NULLs ignored. - unique_teams_hired_for and unique_locations_hired_for as distinct counts. - requisition_fill_rate = filled/total as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no requisitions. - Posting effectiveness per owner_user_id: - Distinct counts of postings and by state (published, closed). - Averages from posting_performance: avg_applications_per_posting, avg_posting_conversion_rate, avg_posting_performance_score. - high_performing_postings = postings with performance_tier = ''High Performing''; postings_with_no_applications = total_applications = 0. - departments_managed and teams_managed as distinct category counts. - high_performing_posting_rate = high_performing_postings/total as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no postings. - Candidate management per posting_hiring_manager_user_id: - Distinct counts: total_candidates_managed (opportunities) and total_applications_overseen. - Averages over candidate_lifecycle: avg_candidate_lifecycle_days, avg_stages_per_candidate, avg_interview_completion_rate. - Outcome counts: candidates_hired if stage_name contains ''hire'' or ''accept'' (case-insensitive); offers_extended if contains ''offer''; candidates_rejected if archived_at present. - Candidate experience: average overall_candidate_experience_score; positive_experience_candidates for grades in {''Exceptional Experience'',''Excellent Experience''}. - candidate_hire_rate = candidates_hired/total_candidates_managed as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when none. - Interview coordination per posting_hiring_manager_user_id: - Distinct interviews coordinated; successful if not canceled; canceled if canceled. - Unique interviewers engaged; average interview duration. - Feedback: total_feedback_collected = distinct feedback_form_id; completed_feedback_collected = distinct feedback_form_id. - feedback_completion_rate_managed = distinct non-null feedback_form_id / distinct feedback_form_id as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when none. - interview_success_rate = successful/total as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when none. - Time efficiency per posting_hiring_manager_user_id (joining funnel metrics via applications, thus weighting postings by application volume): - Averages of avg_days_to_screening, avg_days_screening_to_technical, avg_total_days_to_hire. - high_efficiency_postings = distinct postings with hiring_efficiency_grade = ''High Efficiency (≥10%)''. - decision_speed_category from avg_total_days_to_hire thresholds: <=30 Fast, <=45 Standard, <=60 Deliberate, else Slow. - Final assembly per hiring_manager_id: - Pass identity fields; coalesce numeric metrics to 0 and decision_speed_category to ''Unknown''. - overall_performance_score = rounded (0 decimals), clamped [0,100] sum of: - 0.25*requisition_fill_rate + 0.25*high_performing_posting_rate + 0.25*candidate_hire_rate + 0.15*interview_success_rate - plus time-efficiency bonus based on avg_total_days_to_hire: +10 if <=45 else decreasing by 0.2 per day above 45, floored at 0; if avg_total_days_to_hire is missing, the score is NULL. - performance_tier by score thresholds: >=80 Outstanding; >=65 Effective; >=50 Competent; else Developing if total_candidates_managed>=5, otherwise New/Limited Experience. - hiring_specialization first-match: high_performing_posting_rate>=70 → Job Marketing Expert; else avg_candidate_experience_score>=4.0 → Candidate Experience Specialist; else feedback_completion_rate_managed>=85 → Process Coordinator; else avg_total_days_to_hire<=30 → Fast Decision Maker; else teams_supported>=3 → Multi-Team Recruiter; else Generalist. - development_recommendations = concatenation (in order) of segments with "; " when condition met: requisition_fill_rate<50, avg_applications_per_posting<10, interview_success_rate<80, avg_total_days_to_hire>60; empty string if none. - calculated_at = current query timestamp. - Order output by overall_performance_score descending, then total_candidates_hired descending.'

contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: 'Build daily account-level conversion funnel metrics and 30-day cohort summaries: - daily_events (union all) - Page views: from staging.stg_pendo__event as event_type=page_view; fields include visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date (day-level from occurred_at), entity_id=page_id, num_events, num_minutes. - Feature interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event as event_type=feature_click; entity_id=feature_id; carry num_events and num_minutes. - Deep page interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__page_event as event_type=page_interaction; per visitor/account/app/day/page aggregate counts of interactions (num_events) and summed minutes (num_minutes). - user_daily_funnel (per visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date) - Presence flags by type: has_page_view, has_feature_interaction, has_deep_interaction set to 1 if any such event exists that day, else 0. - Distinct entities: unique_pages_viewed, unique_features_used, unique_pages_interacted are distinct counts of entity_id by type. - Totals: total_page_events/total_feature_events/total_interaction_events and corresponding minutes are summed by type. - funnel_progression (per visitor/day) - Funnel stage precedence: Deep Engaged (all three flags=1) > Feature User (page and feature flags=1) > Page Visitor (page flag=1) > No Activity. - engagement_score = 0.1×total_page_events + 0.3×total_feature_events + 0.6×total_interaction_events + 0.05×(total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes). - session_quality: High Quality if total_minutes≥10 and unique_pages_viewed≥3 and unique_features_used≥2; else Medium Quality if total_minutes≥5 and unique_pages_viewed≥2; else Low Quality if total_page_minutes≥1; else Bounce. Here total_minutes = total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes. - account_funnel_metrics (per account_id, app_id, event_date) - Visitor counts: total_visitors = distinct visitor_id; visitors_with_page_views/features/deep = distinct visitors with the corresponding presence flag=1. - Conversion rates: page_to_feature = visitors_with_feature_use / visitors_with_page_views; feature_to_deep = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_feature_use; overall = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_page_views. If the denominator is 0, the rate is NULL. - Averages: avg_engagement_score and avg_pages_per_visitor are averaged over visitors with has_page_view=1; avg_features_per_user over visitors with has_feature_interaction=1; if no qualifying visitors, result is NULL. - Quality rates: high_quality_session_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''High Quality'' divided by total_visitors; bounce_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''Bounce'' divided by total_visitors; NULL if total_visitors=0. - conversion_cohort_analysis (per account_id, app_id; joined back to each daily row) - 30-day rolling averages relative to today (lower bound inclusive): average of daily page_to_feature, feature_to_deep, and overall conversion rates for dates on or after 30 days before today. - conversion_rate_trend = average overall conversion rate for dates on or after 7 days before today minus the average for dates from 30 to 7 days before today; both windows include the day 7 days ago. - funnel_health_rating by the 30-day average overall rate: Excellent (≥0.3), Good (≥0.2), Fair (≥0.1), else Poor. If the 30-day average is NULL, rating is Poor. - optimization_recommendation (first matching rule): if the 30-day average page→feature rate < 0.2 then “Focus on feature discovery and onboarding”; else if the 30-day average feature→deep rate < 0.3 then “Improve feature engagement and user guidance”; else if the 30-day average bounce rate > 0.6 then “Reduce bounce rate through better landing experience”; else “Maintain current optimization efforts”. - Final step: left join the cohort metrics to the daily account_funnel_metrics by account_id and app_id; set calculated_at to the query execution timestamp. count groups with sum > 10000. - duplicate_primary_keys: difference between total events and distinct event_key. - inactive_paying_accounts: accounts with no events in the last 90 days. 4) Summary quality metrics: - completeness_score: compute the share of complete records by subtracting the ratio of (sum of NULL primary keys + sum of missing names + sum of missing first visits) to (three times the sum of total records) from 1, then multiply by 100; return NULL if the denominator is zero. - consistency_score: compute 1 minus the ratio of total consistency violations to the overall total records, then multiply by 100; return NULL if the denominator is zero. - business_logic_score: compute 1 minus the ratio of total business logic violations to the overall total records, then multiply by 100; return NULL if the denominator is zero. - These totals are evaluated over a Cartesian product of the completeness, consistency, and business-logic CTEs, so each component’s sum is multiplied by the row counts of the other two CTEs. - calculated_at uses the current time. 5) Final UNION ALL report rows: - Data Quality Summary: 1 row with the three percentage scores; overall_quality_score is their average; quality_grade is Excellent (>=95), Good (>=85), Fair (>=70), else Poor; calculated_at from the summary CTE. - Data Completeness Details: one row per table_name with column mapping by position: table_name (text), total_records, null_primary_keys, missing_names, missing_first_visit (as text), and calculated_at as current time. - Data Consistency Issues: one row per check_type with column mapping by position: check_type (text), total_violations, NULL, NULL, violation_description (text), and calculated_at as current time. - Business Logic Violations: one row per violation_type with column mapping by position: violation_type (text), violation_count, NULL, NULL, description (text), and calculated_at as current time. contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: 'Build a comprehensive customer record per visitor_id by joining base visitor activity with lifecycle, RFM, and product health, then derive journey labels, values, and recommendations: 1) Base rowset and joins - Start from marts.pendo__visitor (vb), one row per visitor_id; carry: visitor_id, account_id, first_event_on, last_event_on, count_active_days, count_active_months, sum_events, sum_minutes, average_daily_events, average_daily_minutes, count_associated_accounts. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__user_lifecycle_segments (lc) on visitor_id. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__customer_rfm_analysis (rfm) on visitor_id. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics (ph) on account_id. - Null policy: Left joins may yield missing lifecycle/RFM/health attributes; unless explicitly defaulted in rules below, missing values do not match conditions and fall to the default outcome. 2) Customer segmentation label (customer_segment_label) evaluated in order: - Power User + Champions → "Star Customer" - (Mature User or Power User) + High Value → "Key Account" - New User + New Customers → "Fresh Prospect" - Growing User + Potential Loyalists → "Rising Star" - churn_risk_level in (High Risk, Medium Risk) + At Risk → "Save Immediately" - lifecycle_stage = At Risk + action_priority = Re-engagement → "Rescue Mission" - lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Lost Customer" - Else → "Standard Customer" 3) Comprehensive customer value (comprehensive_customer_value, 0–100): - Compute a weighted sum: 40% of user_value_score (defaults to 0 if missing), 30% of (rfm_composite_score scaled to 0–100 by multiplying by 20; defaults to 0 if missing), and 30% of overall_health_score (defaults to 50 if missing). Cap the result at 100. No rounding beyond native numeric evaluation. 4) Recommended next action (recommended_next_action) evaluated in order: - Power User + Champions → "Leverage as advocate; Offer exclusive features; Request testimonials" - is_new_user = true + New Customers → "Intensive onboarding; Feature education; Success manager assignment" - needs_attention = true + action_priority = Re-engagement → "Personalized outreach; Usage analysis; Feature recommendations" - churn_risk_level = High Risk → "Immediate intervention; Executive outreach; Value demonstration" - lifecycle_stage = Growing User → "Feature adoption campaign; Usage optimization; Upgrade path guidance" - rfm_segment = Loyal Customers → "Upsell opportunities; Loyalty rewards; Advanced feature training" - Else → "Standard nurturing; Regular check-ins; Content engagement" 5) Customer journey stage (customer_journey_stage): - Define days since first event as the number of days from the first_event_on date to today. - If days since first event ≤ 30 → "Onboarding" - Else if lifecycle_stage in (Growing User, Mature User) and customer_value_tier in (High Value, Medium Value) → "Growth" - Else if lifecycle_stage in (Power User, Mature User) and rfm_segment in (Champions, Loyal Customers) → "Maturity" - Else if churn_risk_level in (High Risk, Medium Risk) or lifecycle_stage = At Risk → "Retention" - Else if lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Win-back" - Else → "Maintenance" 6) Predicted LTV tier (predicted_ltv_tier) evaluated in order: - lifecycle_stage in (Power User, Mature User) + customer_value_tier = High Value + overall_health_score ≥ 70 (treat missing health as 60 for this rule) → "Very High LTV" - (user_value_score ≥ 70 or rfm_composite_score ≥ 4) + churn_risk_level = Low Risk → "High LTV" - lifecycle_stage in (Growing User, New User) + predicted_clv_tier in (High CLV, Medium CLV) → "Moderate LTV" - churn_risk_level = High Risk or lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Low LTV" - Else → "Standard LTV" 7) Engagement velocity and trends (from comprehensive view): - engagement_velocity: ratio of count_active_days to days since first event; if either value is not positive, set to 0. - usage_trend: define a baseline average as sum_events divided by count_active_days when count_active_days > 0; if average_daily_events exceeds the baseline by more than 20% → "Accelerating"; if within ±20% → "Stable"; otherwise → "Declining". When count_active_days = 0, the baseline is undefined and the outcome is "Declining". - account_influence_level: count_associated_accounts > 3 → "Multi-Account Influencer"; > 1 → "Cross-Account User"; else → "Single Account User". - calculated_at: timestamp when the metrics are computed. 8) Final importance and investment expectation: - customer_importance_level (in order): - customer_segment_label in (Star Customer, Key Account) + predicted_ltv_tier = Very High LTV → "Critical" - comprehensive_customer_value ≥ 80 + customer_journey_stage in (Growth, Maturity) → "High" - comprehensive_customer_value ≥ 60 or customer_segment_label in (Rising Star, Fresh Prospect) → "Medium" - needs_attention = true or customer_journey_stage = Retention → "At Risk" - Else → "Standard" - investment_expectation: - Star Customer → "High ROI - Advocacy & Expansion" - Key Account → "High ROI - Retention & Upsell" - Rising Star → "Medium ROI - Growth Investment" - Fresh Prospect → "Medium ROI - Onboarding Investment" - Save Immediately → "Low ROI - Retention Cost" - Lost Customer → "Negative ROI - Win-back Cost" - Else → "Standard ROI - Maintenance" 9) Output all selected and derived columns; no additional filtering; grain remains one row per visitor_id.'

contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: 'Build per-customer behavior and segmentation by: - Source inputs: - Marketo (intermediate.int_customer360__marketo) per lead_id - Stripe (intermediate.int_customer360__stripe) per customer_id - Zendesk (intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk) per user_id - Identity map (intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches) providing the cross-platform ID linkage - Per-platform metrics: - Marketo: - marketo_first_touch = created_at; marketo_last_activity = updated_at - marketo_engagement_score: - 0 if is_unsubscribed = true or is_email_invalid = true - else 3 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 2 if < 90 - else 1 - has_organization_data = 1 if organization_name_no_suffix not null and length > 3 else 0 - has_phone_contact = 1 if phone or mobile_phone present else 0 - address_completeness_score: - 3 if country_code, state_code, and city all present - 2 if country_code present and at least one of state_code or city present - 1 if only country_code present - 0 otherwise - Stripe: - stripe_first_transaction = created_at; stripe_last_activity = updated_at - stripe_engagement_score: - 0 if is_deleted = true - 1 if is_delinquent = true (and not deleted) - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - payment_reliability_score: - 3 if is_delinquent = false and is_deleted = false - 1 if is_delinquent = true and is_deleted = false - 0 otherwise - billing_completeness_score: - 2 if customer_address_line_1 and customer_country_code present - 1 if only customer_country_code present - 0 otherwise - Zendesk: - zendesk_first_contact = created_at; zendesk_last_activity = updated_at - zendesk_engagement_score: - 0 if is_suspended = true or is_deleted = true - 1 if is_active = false - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - org_relationship_strength: - 2 if organization_id and organization_name_no_suffix present - 1 if only organization_id present - 0 otherwise - Join and aggregate: - Left join per-platform metrics to source_matches on respective IDs - primary_email = coalesce(Marketo.email, Stripe.email, Zendesk.email); rows with NULL primary_email are excluded - email_domain and primary_organization use the same COALESCE order (Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk) - customer_first_touchpoint = the earliest of the three per-platform first-touch timestamps - customer_last_activity = the latest of the three per-platform last-activity timestamps - If any of the three timestamps is NULL, the earliest/latest result is NULL - marketo_engagement/stripe_engagement/zendesk_engagement = respective per-platform scores with NULL → 0 - composite_engagement_score = weighted average (weights: Marketo 0.3, Stripe 0.5, Zendesk 0.2), rounded to two decimals and stored with one decimal precision - in_marketo/in_stripe/in_zendesk = 1 if respective joined record exists, else 0 - organization_data_quality = coalesce(has_organization_data,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(org_relationship_strength,0) - has_contact_phone = coalesce(has_phone_contact, 0) - address_data_quality = coalesce(address_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) - marketing_to_sales_days = days between Marketo first touch and Stripe first transaction only if both present; else NULL - sales_to_support_days = days between Stripe first transaction and Zendesk first contact only if both present; else NULL - account_age_days = days between the earliest available first-touch and current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL - customer_maturity (derived from the same earliest timestamp vs current_date): - ''New Customer'' if < 90 days - ''Growing Relationship'' if < 365 days - ''Established Customer'' if < 1095 days - ''Long-term Customer'' otherwise (including when the start date is NULL) - customer_journey_pattern based on platform presence, evaluated in this order: - ''Full Journey'' if all three present - ''Marketing to Sales'' if Marketo and Stripe - ''Sales to Support'' if Stripe and Zendesk - ''Marketing to Support'' if Marketo and Zendesk - ''Marketing Only'' if only Marketo - ''Sales Only'' if only Stripe - ''Support Only'' if only Zendesk - ''Unknown'' otherwise - payment_reliability = coalesce(Stripe.payment_reliability_score, 0) - Classification: - customer_segment (first match wins): - ''Champion'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''Loyal Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.0 and customer_journey_pattern = ''Full Journey'' - ''Potential Loyalist'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''New Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.0 and account_age_days < 90 - ''At Risk'' if composite_engagement_score >= 1.5 - ''Hibernating'' if composite_engagement_score > 0 - ''Lost'' otherwise - churn_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if payment_reliability = 0 or composite_engagement_score < 1 - ''Medium Risk'' if composite_engagement_score < 2 and account_age_days > 365 - ''Medium Risk'' if customer_last_activity is more than 90 days ago - ''Low Risk'' otherwise (including when comparisons evaluate to NULL) - recommended_action based on customer_segment: - ''Upsell/Cross-sell'' for ''Champion'' or ''Loyal Customer'' - ''Engagement Campaign'' for ''Potential Loyalist'' - ''Onboarding Focus'' for ''New Customer'' - ''Win-back Campaign'' for ''At Risk'' - ''Reactivation Campaign'' for ''Hibernating'' - ''Recovery Campaign'' otherwise - Output filter and ordering: - Keep only rows where primary_email is not NULL - Order rows by composite_engagement_score descending, then account_age_days descending'

contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: 'Starting from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (one row per resolved customer), compute lifecycle metrics and enrichments: - Activity windows and recency: - days_since_last_activity = number of days between customer_last_activity and today; NULL if customer_last_activity is missing. - active_X_days flags (X ∈ {30,60,90,180,365}) = 1 if customer_last_activity occurred within X days of today, else 0; missing customer_last_activity yields 0. - Lifecycle stage (first match wins): - ''Acquisition'' if account_age_days ≤ 30 - ''Activation'' if account_age_days ≤ 90 and last_activity within 30 days - ''Growth'' if account_age_days ≤ 365 and last_activity within 60 days - ''Maturity'' if account_age_days > 365 and last_activity within 90 days - ''Dormant'' if last_activity older than 180 days - Else ''Retention'' - Note: NULL account_age_days or last_activity causes earlier conditions to fail and typically falls through to ''Retention''. - Cohort and platform consistency: - acquisition_cohort_month = month of the first touchpoint (truncated to month); NULL if first_touchpoint is missing. - platform_consistency_score ∈ {1,2,3}: sum of presence flags (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); 3 if sum ≥ 3, 2 if sum = 2, else 1. NULL in any flag leads to the else path → 1. - Value and engagement scores: - estimated_customer_value (DECIMAL(6,2)) by customer_segment: - ''Champion'' 5000.00; ''Loyal Customer'' 3500.00; ''Potential Loyalist'' 2000.00; ''New Customer'' 800.00; ''At Risk'' 1200.00; ''Hibernating'' 500.00; else 200.00. - frequency_score (1–5): 5 if platform_consistency_score = 3 and active_30_days = 1; 4 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_60_days = 1; 3 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_90_days = 1; 2 if active_180_days = 1; else 1. - recency_score (1–5) by days_since_last_activity: 5 (≤7), 4 (≤30), 3 (≤60), 2 (≤180), else 1; NULL days_since_last_activity maps to 1. - estimated_transaction_count (DOUBLE): simulated per run: - If segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') → integer 2–9 - If ''Potential Loyalist'' → integer 1–4 - Else → integer 0–1 - Stored as DOUBLE; values vary each execution. - customer_health_score (DECIMAL(15,2)) = rounded to 2 decimals from: recency_component*0.3 + platform_consistency_score*0.3 + segment_component*0.4, where: - recency_component: 5/4/3/2/1 as in recency_score logic - segment_component: ''Champion'' 5.0; ''Loyal Customer'' 4.5; ''Potential Loyalist'' 3.5; ''New Customer'' 3.0; ''At Risk'' 2.0; ''Hibernating'' 1.5; else 1.0 - Advanced lifecycle metrics: - estimated_customer_ltv (DECIMAL(18,2)) = estimated_customer_value × (1 + 0.2 × frequency_score) × (1 + 0.1 × platform_consistency_score) × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals, where stage_factor: Growth 1.5; Maturity 2.0; Retention 1.8; Activation 1.2; else 1.0. - retention_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) by customer_health_score: ≥4.5→0.95; ≥4.0→0.85; ≥3.5→0.75; ≥3.0→0.65; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.35; else 0.20. - churn_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) inverse mapping: ≥4.5→0.05; ≥4.0→0.15; ≥3.5→0.25; ≥3.0→0.35; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.65; else 0.80. - revenue_at_risk (DECIMAL(9,2)) = estimated_customer_value × churn-probability mapping above; rounded to 2 decimals. - growth_potential (first match wins): - ''High Growth Potential'' if lifecycle_stage in (''Acquisition'',''Activation'') and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - ''Expansion Ready'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - ''Upsell Candidate'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Maturity'' and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 - ''Stable Account'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Retention'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.0 - ''Reactivation Needed'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' - Else ''Monitor'' - action_priority (INT, first match wins): - 5 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.65 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Acquisition'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - 3 if customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 and estimated_customer_value ≥ 3000 - 3 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.35 - Else 2 - acquisition_year = year of acquisition_cohort_month; acquisition_month = month number; months_since_acquisition = whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL. - acquisition_season: ''Holiday Season'' if month in (11,12,1); ''Summer Season'' if in (6,7,8); ''Spring Season'' if in (3,4,5); else ''Fall Season'' (default for NULL or not matched). - Final enrichments: - customer_tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic. - is_strategic_account = TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 OR (customer_segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') AND platform_consistency_score = 3); else FALSE. - intervention_urgency by action_priority: 5→''Immediate''; 4→''This Week''; 3→''This Month''; else ''Routine''. - expected_retention_rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90 if LTV ≥ 8000; 0.85 if LTV ≥ 5000; 0.75 if LTV ≥ 2500 and lifecycle_stage ≠ ''Dormant''; 0.60 if LTV ≥ 1000 and lifecycle_stage in (''Growth'',''Maturity''); else 0.45. - performance_vs_expectation: ''Above Expectation'' if retention_probability > expected_retention_rate; ''Meeting Expectation'' if retention_probability ≥ 80% of expected_retention_rate; else ''Below Expectation''. - Output ordering: sorted by is_strategic_account (true first), then action_priority descending, then estimated_customer_ltv descending, then customer_health_score descending.'

contract_evidence.quote: business_logic: 'Overview - Start from behavior_analysis (intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis, one row per customer) and left join lifecycle_metrics (intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics) on primary_email. - Enrich with platform data via left joins on platform IDs: - Marketo: intermediate.int_customer360__marketo on lead_id - Stripe: intermediate.int_customer360__stripe on customer_id - Zendesk: intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk on user_id - Filter: exclude rows where primary_email is NULL; no de-duplication beyond joins. - Time anchors: current_date for recency calculations and current_timestamp for activity_analysis_timestamp; results vary by execution time. - Ordering: rows are sorted by activity_priority_score (desc), then weighted_engagement_score (desc), then active_channel_count (desc). Activity recency and counts - days/weeks/months_since_last_activity: difference between customer_last_activity and current_date by unit; returns NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL. - active_channel_count: integer sum (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); if any flag is NULL the sum becomes NULL; expected domain is 0–3 from 0/1 flags. Estimated and adjusted activity (stochastic components) - estimated_monthly_activities: simulated with random() per run based on composite_engagement_score: - >=4.0 → 15 + floor(random()*10) ∈ [15,24] - >=3.0 → 8 + floor(random()*7) ∈ [8,14] - >=2.0 → 3 + floor(random()*5) ∈ [3,7] - >=1.0 → 1 + floor(random()*3) ∈ [1,3] - else → floor(random()*2) ∈ [0,1] - Note: random() yields different results each execution; this column is non-deterministic by design. - seasonally_adjusted_activity: estimated_monthly_activities multiplied by a month factor (Nov/Dec/Jan ×1.2; Jun/Jul/Aug ×0.8; else ×1.0); no rounding. - predicted_next_month_activity: estimated_monthly_activities multiplied by a factor from engagement_velocity category (Accelerating ×1.3; Steady High ×1.1; Steady Medium ×1.0; Declining ×0.7; Slow ×0.4; Stagnant ×0.2); no rounding. Engagement velocity, momentum, maturity (rule-based categories) - engagement_velocity (uses activity recency and composite_engagement_score): - <=7 days and score>=3.0 → Accelerating - <=14 days and score>=2.5 → Steady High - <=30 days and score>=2.0 → Steady Medium - <=60 days → Declining - <=90 days → Slow - else → Stagnant - activity_momentum (uses days_since_last_activity and composite_engagement_score): - <=7 days and score>=3.5 → High Momentum - <=14 days and score>=3.0 → Medium Momentum - <=30 days and score>=2.0 → Low Momentum - <=60 days → Losing Momentum - else → No Momentum - engagement_maturity (uses account_age_days and active_channel_count): - age>=365 and channels>=3 → Mature Multi-channel - age>=180 and channels>=2 → Developing Multi-channel - age>=90 and channels>=1 → Single Channel Engaged - age<90 → Early Stage - else → Minimal Engagement Channel scores and depths - marketing_engagement_score: if in_marketo=1 and is_unsubscribed=false and is_email_invalid=false then round(marketo_engagement × (1 − days since last Marketo update / 90), 2); else 0; may be negative; if the last update timestamp is NULL the result is NULL in the true branch. - sales_engagement_score: if in_stripe=1 and is_deleted=false and is_delinquent=false then round(stripe_engagement × (1 − days since last Stripe update / 60), 2); else 0; may be negative; NULL if the last update timestamp is NULL in the true branch. - support_engagement_score: if in_zendesk=1 and is_active=true and is_suspended=false and is_deleted=false then round(zendesk_engagement × (1 − days since last Zendesk update / 120), 2); else 0; may be negative; NULL if the last update timestamp is NULL in the true branch. - primary_engagement_channel: choose the channel with the highest raw engagement; ties break in order Marketing Driven > Sales Driven > Support Driven; if comparisons do not resolve (e.g., NULL inputs) fallback is Balanced. - marketing_depth/sales_depth/support_depth (per channel): if in_* = 1: engagement>=4 → Deep; engagement>=2 → Medium; else → Shallow; if in_*=0 → None. Cross-platform and composite scores - cross_platform_consistency: round( average of raw engagement across platforms where in_*=1, 2 decimals ); returns NULL if no active platforms or if any included operand (flags or raw engagements) is NULL. - activity_efficiency: round(composite_engagement_score divided by active_channel_count, 2); NULL if active_channel_count is 0 or NULL. - weighted_engagement_score: round(0.3×marketing_engagement_score (NULL→0) + 0.5×sales_engagement_score (NULL→0) + 0.2×support_engagement_score (NULL→0), 2); can be negative. - activity_grade: from weighted_engagement_score and active_channel_count: >=4.0 & channels>=3 → A+; >=3.5 & channels>=2 → A; >=3.0 → B+; >=2.5 → B; >=2.0 → C+; >=1.5 → C; >=1.0 → D; else → F. - activity_priority_score: round(0.4×weighted_engagement_score + 0.3×active_channel_count + 0.3×priority_component, 2) where priority_component is 5/4/3/2/1 by recency+composite rules (<=7 days & score>=3.5 → 5; <=14 & score>=3.0 → 4; <=30 & score>=2.0 → 3; <=60 → 2; else → 1). Risk and interventions - activity_risk_level: if days_since_last_activity>90 and customer_health_score<3.0 → High Activity Risk; else if days_since_last_activity>60 or active_channel_count=1 → Medium Activity Risk; else if days_since_last_activity>30 → Low Activity Risk; else → No Activity Risk. - recommended_activity_intervention (evaluated top-to-bottom): Declining/Slow/Stagnant with health>=3.0 → Re-engagement Campaign; else single channel (count=1) with composite>=2.5 → Channel Expansion; else Marketing Driven with in_stripe=0 → Sales Conversion Focus; else Sales Driven with in_zendesk=0 → Success Onboarding; else recent (<=7 days) with composite>=3.5 → Upsell Opportunity; else Standard Engagement.'

This can yield duplicates relative to the full outer joins. 3) For each row, derive customer360_organization_id by hashing the pipe-joined values (marketo org name without suffix, marketo inferred org name without suffix, stripe customer org name without suffix, stripe shipping org name without suffix, zendesk organization_id), treating nulls as empty strings. 4) Emit two row types: - Individual rows (is_organization_header=false): include the three source IDs; source_ids is a compact JSON-like object {"marketo":"...","stripe":"...","zendesk":"..."} where null IDs are rendered as empty strings; timestamps are the per-row values from step 2. - One organization header row per customer360_organization_id (is_organization_header=true): source IDs are null; source_ids is a JSON-like object with arrays per system containing distinct quoted IDs for that organization (comma-delimited, no spaces), with nulls rendered as empty strings; timestamps aggregated per organization as latest updated_at and earliest created_at for each system; zendesk organization timestamps use latest for updated and earliest for created. 5) Assign customer360_id by hashing the pipe-joined values (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, is_organization_header, customer360_organization_id), treating nulls as empty strings and using the engine’s string form of the boolean.'

averages ignore NULLs and use smaller windows at the start. - 30-day lags: prior 30th-day values for spend and conversions for month-over-month comparisons. - Efficiency metrics (rounded to 4 decimals): - CTR: percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks; 0 when impressions <= 0. - CPC: spend per click; 0 when clicks <= 0. - CPM: spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when impressions <= 0. - Cost per conversion: spend per conversion; NULL when conversions <= 0. - ROAS: conversion value divided by spend; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0. - Compute account_scoring: - days_since_first_activity: days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative. - performance_score: clamp to 0–100 for the sum of: CTR*10; ROAS*10 capped at 50; +20 if cost_per_conversion < 50; and either +10 if clicks_7d_avg > 100 else + (clicks_7d_avg / 10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL. - spend_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend when the lag > 0;
